title: ThemeCreateRequest
description: The ONLY schema a client-supplied POST /themes body is validated against. Deliberately has no factor_weights field - this is not an oversight. factor_weights is never user input; it is loaded server-side from config/factor_weights.yaml by the handler and is not settable through this or any other endpoint. additionalProperties is false specifically so that a client mistakenly submitting factor_weights gets a hard 422, not a silently-ignored field - silent ignoring would let someone believe they customized weighting policy when they didn't.

sub_exposures.description: 3-6 sub-exposure keys. Each MUST match a key in config/sub_exposure_etf_map.yaml (SCREENER_SKILL.md) - validated at creation time, not deferred to Screener run time.

screens.description: Optional overrides of the default liquidity/diversification screens. Unlike factor_weights, these ARE legitimate per-theme user input - a theme targeting micro-cap names may reasonably want a lower min_market_cap, for example. This is a deliberate distinction: screens are risk/eligibility parameters the requester should control; factor_weights is scoring methodology, which is not a per-request customization.

weighting_scheme.description: Basket position-sizing method (ARCHITECTURE.md section 5.4) - NOT to be confused with factor_weights. This controls how the 8-10 final positions are sized against each other; factor_weights controls how candidates are scored/ranked in the first place. Legitimate user input for the same reason screens are.
